title: Duality for Interpolation Spaces Defined Via Slowly Varying Functions: The Case 0<q<1
summary: Given $(A_0, A_1)$ a compatible couple of Banach spaces, we describe the dual of the limiting real interpolation space $(A_0, A_1)^{K}_{ 1,q,b}$ for $0 < q < 1$ and $b$ a slowly varying function. In the process, we use the $J$-spaces $(A_0, A_1)^{J}_{ 1,q,b}$ and we establish an equivalence theorem for $K$ and $J$ spaces of independent interest. We also give examples that recover known results on this topic.
